# Bug Report

## What happened?

Clearly describe the issue you found.

## Where did you find it?

`prompts/master-prompt.md`

## Expected behavior

## Actual behavior

What actually happened?

## Additional context

Add any other information, examples, or screenshots that may help explain the issue.

## Possible solution

If you have an idea about how this could be improved, share it here.
